$comment: Shot list entry (sand-y0u.6): the manifest is ahead of the binary. The image has NOT been fetched yet — run the download in docs/imagery-phase-1.md, then `npm run media`. Provenance verified against the archive record on 2026-08-24.

original.description: A press photograph of the mobilization order posted by the military government of Paris. Catalogued by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as "Ordre de mobilisation émanant du gouvernement militaire de Paris : photographie de presse", subject headings "Guerre mondiale (1914-1918); France. Armée -- Mobilisation; Affiches -- France -- Paris (France)", coverage August 1914.
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection, reference Rol 41830; digitised on Gallica (btv1b6931266f), via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"). Credit line on the record: Bibliothèque nationale de France.

colorization.status: not colorized, and should not be — a document is read, not looked at, and colour would add nothing but a claim.

content_policy: ok — a printed poster, no gore
caption: The mobilization order of the military government of Paris, August 1914 — the piece of paper the crowd in the street outside was reading.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, Rol 41830, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Two other Commons photographs of mobilization posters were checked and rejected for this slot because their records date the *photograph* to 1918 (btv1b530054761) and 1928 (btv1b53206326g) — the poster is 1914, the exposure is not, and a document card should not blur the two.
